description.text: Objective: Through study, students could learn and understand Chinese human geography, be familiar with Chinese customs, be proficient in tourism listening and tour guide oral, and be engaged in the basic work related to tourism. Characteristics: Simulation travel & small size & intership Courses: Practical Chinese Listening and Reading, Practical Comprehensive Chinese, Daily Chinese Conversation, Chinese Culture, Chinese Human Geography, Tourism Management, Travel Around China, Tour Guide Oral, and Tourism Listening etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.

duration.text: The Tourism Culture Program at Ludong University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1180 USD/per semester ￥ 8500 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate of HSK If applicable. Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), No need for English medium programs

requirements.text: 1.(Applicants must be) non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.New HSK Level 4 or above
